content.title: Identity body jump | Upgrade of cross-land and air vehicles with the same characteristics
content.summary: A recognizable identity is first established, and then its core features are continuously embedded into mobile bodies with gradually increasing functional levels; each stage simultaneously retains the identity anchor and the visible functions of the new body, and finally crosses into a new movement category and ends with a complete hybrid.

quick_start.input_format: Identity Anchor + At least three mobile bodies + Retain identity and add visible functionality at each stage + Upgrades across movement categories + Complete hybrid final state
quick_start.recommended_input: In the original polar research cabin, a graphite-colored sensing disk is placed on the ice, and the triangular amber mark on the front and the three-point signature on the side light up once at the same time; the sampler is compressed in front of the narrow crack and connected to the double-roller cable car, the identity mark remains forward, and the rollers traverse the crack along the tensioned steel cable; the weather probe finally glides completely with wide wind wings, stable wings and the original sensing surface, and the amber identity anchor point and aerial functions are readable at the same time
required_anchors: Establish one identity motif with at least two stable visual anchors before machine integration begins.
Show the motif physically merging with the first mobility body rather than cutting to a finished replacement.
Escalate through another mobility realization with a visibly different affordance.
Finish with one larger mobility-class change and hold identity plus function together.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A recognizable identity is first established, and then its core features are continuously embedded into mobile bodies with gradually increasing functional levels; each stage simultaneously retains the identity anchor and the visible functions of the new body, and finally crosses into a new movement category and ends with a complete hybrid.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish one unmistakable identity motif before any transformation, then migrate that motif through a sequence of complete mobility bodies whose functional class visibly escalates. Each stage must preserve at least two identity anchors while adding one readable new mobility affordance; do not replace one object with an unrelated one. Reserve the largest category change for the final stage and hold the completed identity-machine hybrid long enough to verify both continuity and new function.

invariants.rule: Establish one identity motif with at least two stable visual anchors before machine integration begins.
invariants.ablation_failure: Starting on a hybrid gives no proof that identity survived the transition.

invariants.rule: Show the motif physically merging with the first mobility body rather than cutting to a finished replacement.
invariants.purpose: Binds carrier change to the original identity.
invariants.ablation_failure: A hard swap reads as unrelated object replacement.

invariants.rule: Complete one functional mobility class while keeping the identity anchors visibly active.
invariants.purpose: Proves that the hybrid is more than decorative texture.
invariants.ablation_failure: A static themed shell does not demonstrate a carrier role.

invariants.rule: Escalate through another mobility realization with a visibly different affordance.
invariants.purpose: Builds a capability ladder instead of repeated reskins.
invariants.ablation_failure: Changing only color or bodywork leaves the mechanism flat.

invariants.rule: Finish with one larger mobility-class change and hold identity plus function together.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending mid-morph prevents verification of the new class.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source wet modern city street
the source silver sports car, black motorcycle and helicopter forms
the source cat face integrated into vehicle noses
the source exact ground-car-motorcycle-rotorcraft order and Hailuo/MiniMax watermarks

instantiations.concept: In an original polar research bay, a triangular amber survey glyph is first projected on a compact sensor puck. The glyph migrates into a treaded ice sampler, then a cable-skimming crevasse carriage and finally a silent kite-wing weather probe; the same triangular pulse and three-dot signature remain visible at every stage while each carrier demonstrates its distinct movement.

instantiations.concept: In tactile paper theatre, one blue spiral emblem begins on a wind-up bead. The emblem becomes the face of a crawling paper beetle, then a rolling accordion drum, then a suspended ribbon glider and finally a buoyant lantern craft; folds, camera carrier and movement axes change while the spiral and two silver tabs persist.
